note: Envoys from neighbouring realms. {ruler}, {realm} and {gateway} are filled in. Effects: relation, treasury, trust (M24 B: Love, was Trust), opinion (by group), settlers (people added to the gateway), losses (soldiers lost at the gateway). If ignored for envoyDefaultDays, the choice marked default is taken.

trade_pact.title: A trade pact
trade_pact.text: Envoys of {ruler} propose lower tolls on both sides of the border. The merchants of {gateway} are already counting the profit.

border_dispute.title: A border dispute
border_dispute.text: Surveyors from {realm} have planted stakes in the meadows beyond {gateway} and claim them for {ruler}.

refugees.title: Refugees at the border
refugees.text: Hungry families from {realm} gather on the road outside {gateway}, begging to be let in.

marriage.title: An offer of marriage
marriage.text: {ruler} proposes a match between a child of {realm}'s royal house and a Temerian lord's heir. A dowry is expected.

loan.title: A request for a loan
loan.text: {ruler}'s treasury is bare. Their envoy asks, with some embarrassment, for five hundred crowns.

smugglers.title: Smugglers
smugglers.text: Carts from {realm} are slipping untaxed goods past the customs house at {gateway}. Their merchants say it was ever thus.

dwarven_smiths.title: The smiths of Mahakam
dwarven_smiths.text: The Elders of Mahakam ask that dwarven smiths be free to work in Temerian towns without guild licence.

dryad_arrows.title: Arrows from Brokilon
dryad_arrows.text: Woodcutters from {gateway} strayed too near Brokilon. Three came back. The rest lie with dryad arrows in them.

choices.label: Send soldiers to the edge of the wood

spy.title: A spy in Vizima
spy.text: The watch has taken a man in Vizima with letters for {ruler} sewn into his coat.

choices.label: Send him home for a ransom
